description: This file defines the AuthService class, which handles user registration and authentication, interacting with a user repository, security functions, and database session.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service for authentication and user registration, providing methods to register and authenticate users.

methods.name: User register_user(self, email: str, password: str, is_admin: bool = False)
methods.description: Registers a new user if the email is not already registered, returning the User object.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str,User] authenticate(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returning access token, refresh token, and user object.

ctags.name: authenticate
ctags.pattern: /^    def authenticate(self, email: str, password: str) -> Tuple[str, str, User]:$/

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^    def register_user(self, email: str, password: str, is_admin: bool = False) -> User:$/
ctags.signature: (self, email: str, password: str, is_admin: bool = False)
